d:
Jharkhand ke palamu jile ke kshetr men bal vivah ko rokne ke lie mahilaen ekjut ho rahin hain. mahila bal taskari ke khilaph bhi aavaj utha rahin hain. janjatiy gaurav divas ke mauke par rajy sarkar kaee tarah ka karyakramon ka aayojan kar rahi hai. isi kari men palamu men bal vivah rokne, bal taskari rokne, laingik bhedbhav khatm karne ke lie jagrukta abhiyan chalaya ja raha hai.
